task_instance: Audit a small sample static website (deliberately containing a render-blocking script/stylesheet, an unoptimized 1.4MB hero image, and an image missing width/height) for Core Web Vitals and Lighthouse performance, producing a prioritized findings report with quantified savings and code fixes, matching the skill's Output Format.
evidence: Built a sample site at site/index.html (+styles.css, blocking.js, app.js, 1.4MB hero.jpg) with intentional perf issues, served it via `python3 -m http.server 8834`. No system Chrome/chrome-devtools-mcp was available, so installed puppeteer (`npm install puppeteer`) which downloaded a real headless Chrome binary (Chrome for Testing 154.0.8037.57), then ran `npx lighthouse http://localhost:8834/index.html --output=json --output=html --output-path=./report --chrome-flags='--headless=new --no-sandbox' --only-categories=performance,accessibility`. This produced report.report.json and report.report.html. Verified deliverable by parsing report.report.json: Performance score 72/100, LCP 8.1s (poor, driven by elementRenderDelay=1097ms from the 1.4MB unoptimized hero image per the lcp-breakdown-insight audit), FCP 2.4s, TBT 0ms, CLS 0, render-blocking-insight audit flagged blocking.js (304ms) and styles.css (154ms) with 'Est savings of 1,470 ms', image-delivery-insight flagged hero.jpg with 'Est savings of 1,329 KiB', and unsized-images flagged the hero for missing width/height. These are the same insight categories (LCPBreakdown, RenderBlocking, image delivery) the skill instructs querying via chrome-devtools-mcp's performance_analyze_insight, just obtained through Lighthouse's CLI (same underlying trace/insight engine) since no MCP browser tool or system Chrome was pre-installed. Compiled findings into audit-report.md following the skill's exact Output Format (Core Web Vitals Summary table, prioritized Top Issues with impact levels, specific Recommendations with code snippets, Codebase Findings). All files at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec/cloudflare__skills__web-perf/ (site/, report.report.json, report.report.html, audit-report.md). No credentials, network egress to third parties, or public deployment was needed; local server was stopped afterward.
